notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Verdant Eidolon.
description:
Cast Flourishing Fox either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {W}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Verdant Eidolon due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Flourishing Fox by paying {G} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}.
If you cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard, Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.
